# 某省赛easyRSA-wirteup

> 原文：[http://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?\_\_biz=MzI4NTMyOTY0Mg==&mid=2247483791&idx=1&sn=edc262b12c9ab50953ad59279ee87d46&chksm=ebec900adc9b191c6b8d5634426a268abe01c453b69206d2fb95023964e927e7cda23cd4d52e&scene=126&sessionid=1681668976#rd](http://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzI4NTMyOTY0Mg==&mid=2247483791&idx=1&sn=edc262b12c9ab50953ad59279ee87d46&chksm=ebec900adc9b191c6b8d5634426a268abe01c453b69206d2fb95023964e927e7cda23cd4d52e&scene=126&sessionid=1681668976#rd)

**1、题目：河北省赛一道RSA题目：easyRSA**

**2、题干：给出了密文和公钥文件。flag.enc和pri.pem**

   ![](../Images/70bf5f380bfbcf701bab52cb17d63859.png)

** 3、从公钥中获得e和n**

```
 openssl rsa -pubin -text -modulus -in warmup -in pri.pem
```

得到e和n

![](../Images/4a9cfb744b1ac7164acccbeebad16ccb.png)

```

e=65537
```

n需要由16进制转为10进制

```

```

4、使用yafu分解N得到p和q

```
yafu-x64.exe "factor(@)" -batchfile data.txt  #data.txt内为n，最后一行要注意添加换行后保存。
```

![](../Images/45bebf4ee3c22effe0af48752b6fd1c9.png)

  

```

p = 250527704258269
```

5、 使用rsatool导出私钥文件

```

D:\script\rsatool-master\rsatool-master
```

![](../Images/cf63ae412bb27da1ca3f37dd066bc660.png)

6、使用私钥解密加密文件

![](../Images/189d8ac85f94feba31176c0cbebc5121.png)

```
openssl rsautl -decrypt -in flag.enc -inkey private.pem
```

 ![](../Images/a9fa139b131b042714c223b2b9797294.png)

 得到flag{b7895719d695a2c51d9410fd68f818fe}

rsa基本原理要搞明白。
